forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {控|ひか}えていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to refrain from, to hold back, to moderate
definitions.explanation: To avoid doing something or to reduce the amount of something, often for health or social reasons.
To wait in readiness, often in an official capacity or as a reserve.

definitions.gloss: to be imminent, to be approaching
definitions.explanation: Used to indicate that an event is near or upcoming.

examples.japanese: ⟦プラスチック→プラスチック：00347_purasuchikku⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{控|ひか}える。
examples.english: To refrain from using plastic products.

examples.japanese: ⟦{塩分|えんぶん}→塩分：09945_enbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}え→控え：15908_hikae⟧て⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}え→控え：15908_hikae⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}べない→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: I can't hang out because I have an exam coming up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧{過|す}ぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{控|ひか}える。
⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{控|ひか}え{室|しつ}→控え室：07064_hikaeshitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}っている→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: The players are waiting in the waiting room.

notes:
A versatile ichidan verb with distinct meanings depending on context.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Sense 1 (refrain): ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive) — X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{控|ひか}える
- Senses 2-3 (wait/be imminent): ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)

ASPECT (ている):
- ⟦{控|ひか}え→控え：15908_hikae⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ with sense 1: ongoing restraint
- ⟦{控|ひか}え→控え：15908_hikae⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ with sense 3: something is approaching (⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}え→控え：15908_hikae⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = an exam is coming up)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{控|ひか}える: to refrain from X, to cut back on X
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}え→控え：15908_hikae⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: to have ~ coming up
- ⟦{控|ひか}え{室|しつ}→控え室：07064_hikaeshitsu⟧: waiting room, green room
- ⟦{控|ひか}えめ→控えめ：17234_hikaeme⟧: modest, reserved, restrained

Note: ⟦{控|ひか}えめ→控えめ：17234_hikaeme⟧ (na-adjective/noun) is very common and describes restraint in manner, volume, or quantity.
